messages:
support_jen: Customers reporting p99 latency spike starting ~11:02 UTC; multiple tenants affected, lots of 504s. ticket #4567
sre_oncall_aj: Observed sudden rise in ingress queue depth and worker queue length at 11:02. Admission controller began rejecting low-priority requests but backlog kept growing.
runtime_kunal: Can someone paste the admission and runtime logs? My gut says mixed sequence-length workload causing kernel selection thrash and per-worker inflight cap hits.
infra_bot: Autoscaler event at 11:03: +2 pools started but marked Unhealthy due to model_load failures :x:.
support_jen: Customer repro: single long generate (~12k tokens) followed by a flood of short generates. SDK retries without jitter caused amplification.
product_maria: This impacts 3 paying customers; two have SLAs. Need quick mitigation. Prioritize reducing tails.
runtime_kunal: Hypothesis: long-context call pins resources and forces long-kernel path; then short requests trigger kernel swap or GC, leading to stalls and GPU utilization drop while queue increases.
sre_oncall_aj: Metrics show GPU utilization dropped to 10-20% while queue increased -> runtime stalls (locks or sync). Also per-worker semaphore reached max inflight.
runtime_kunal: Repro script:
```bash
# repro flood
for i in {1..800}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d @short.json &
done
# a long call in parallel
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d @long_12k.json
```
support_jen: Customer confirms they ran similar pattern; they also reported SDK retries with no backoff.
runtime_kunal: Short-term mitigations:
- Lower max_inflight_per_worker 64->32
- Soft-prioritize short requests: admission_holdoff for requests with context>8k tokens
- Route long-context calls to a dedicated pool (if available)
- Fast-fail requests that would block >2s
sre_oncall_aj: Applying hotfix: admission controller will demote ctx>8k to low-priority queue and rate-limit. Pushing to canary.
product_maria: Also consider global SDK retry throttle settings; we should recommend customers enable jitter and backoff.
infra_bot: Canary deployed to rg-runtime-canary-1 at 11:28 UTC. Observability: canary queue depth fell ~30% in 3m.
runtime_kunal: Pushed runtime heuristic to prefer short-seq kernel when >70% inflight are short. Hot restart applied on canary.
sre_oncall_aj: Canary p99 dropped from ~1.8s to ~450ms. Rolling to 20% traffic at 11:35 UTC.
product_maria: Notify affected customers; ask them to pause client retries until rollout completes. Also open postmortem.
support_jen: Informed customers A and B; customer C requested dedicated capacity immediately — ops to follow up.
infra_bot: Rollout progressed 50% at 11:42, 100% at 11:48. No regressions. Previously unhealthy pools recovered.
runtime_kunal: Follow-ups: add ingress sequence-length histogram telemetry, change SDK default retry jitter to 200-500ms, plan queue-aware routing for long calls.
sre_oncall_aj: Filing incident doc and postmortem: https://redwood.ai/pm/INC-789
support_jen: Customers report SLA restored. Closing ticket if stable for 2h.
product_maria: Assigning actionable items and owners. Thanks everyone :tada:
